sine.definition: n. ratio of the length of the side opposite the given angle to the length of the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle

sine die.translation: adv. 无限期地, 无确定日期地

sine qua non.translation: n. 必要条件, 要素

sinecre.translation: [法] 挂名职务, 闲职, 只领工资不做事

sinecure.definition:
n. a benefice to which no spiritual or pastoral duties are attached
n. an office that involves minimal duties
sinecure.translation:
n. 闲职
[经] 领干俸的职位

sinecures.definition:
n. a benefice to which no spiritual or pastoral duties are attached
n. an office that involves minimal duties
sinecures.translation: n. 工作清闲但报酬优厚的职位, 挂名的好差事( sinecure的复数形式 )

sinecurist.definition: n. One who has a sinecure.

sines.definition:
plural of sine
n. ratio of the length of the side opposite the given angle to the length of the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle
sines.translation:
(sine 的复数) n. 正弦
[计] 正弦

sinew.definition:
n a cord or band of inelastic tissue connecting a muscle with its bony attachment
n possessing muscular strength
sinew.translation:
n. 肌肉, 精力, 体力, 力量的源泉, 腱
vt. 赋予力量, 加强

sinewed.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Sinew
a. Furnished with sinews; as, a strong-sinewed youth.
a. Fig.: Equipped; strengthened.
sinewed.translation:
n. 筋；肌腱；体力；精力
vt. 加强；使牢固

sinewing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Sinew
sinewing.translation:
n. 筋；肌腱；体力；精力
vt. 加强；使牢固

sinewless.definition: a. Having no sinews; hence, having no strength or vigor.
sinewless.translation: a. 无腱的, 无精力的, 无气力的

sinews.definition:
n. a cord or band of inelastic tissue connecting a muscle with its bony attachment
n. possessing muscular strength
sinews.translation: n. 腱( sinew的复数形式 ); 肌肉; 精力; 体力

sinewy.definition:
s (of meat) full of sinews; especially impossible to chew
a consisting of tendons or resembling a tendon
s (of a person) possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful
sinewy.translation: a. 强壮的, 结实的, 多腱的
